words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the reader out of the prior compromise scene and into a counter-command. It can be heard as coordination or resumption: the new clause remains connected to 68:9, but it also launches a fresh directive unit. Its own force is limited, because the jussive prohibition belongs to {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) and {{ar:تُطِعْ}} ({{tr:tuṭiʿ}}), yet the fused two-particle opening makes transition and refusal arrive almost together. The ayah therefore begins neither as a hard break nor as a mere consequence, but as connected speech turning immediately into prohibition.

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is the hinge that turns the connected opening into a direct ban. Before the jussive {{ar:تُطِعْ}} ({{tr:tuṭiʿ}}), it is not merely saying that obedience does not happen; it commands that obedience not be given. Its negative force also reaches the object phrase opened by {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}), so the line excludes the described class as an obedience recipient. That two-word refusal also belongs to a wider formula for resisting morally disqualified claimants, while this ayah specializes the formula through its oath-maker portrait. The wider descriptor chain may continue after this ayah, but the local syntax already shows the governing frame: prohibition first, then the character portrait inserted into that ban.

topics.headline: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes a ban, not a report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause is an enacted prohibition addressed to the hearer, not a statement that obedience is absent.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) as prohibitive and governing the jussive {{ar:تُطِعْ}} ({{tr:tuṭiʿ}}).

topics.headline: visible particle opens the command boundary

topics.reason: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) stands separately before the verb, while person and jussive morphology remain on {{ar:تُطِعْ}} ({{tr:tuṭiʿ}}); this makes the scope boundary visible.

topics.headline: negation excludes the described class

topics.reason: The direct object begins with {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}), so {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) plus the quantifier excludes members of the described class; the continuation beyond 68:10 is retained as descriptor-chain pressure, not as an added local parse.

words.prose: {{ar:تُطِعْ}} ({{tr:tuṭiʿ}}) is the act the ayah blocks before the portrait is even completed. The verb is Form IV, jussive under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), and transitive to {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}), so obedience is not left abstract; it is a direct relation toward a named social-moral type. The 2ms prefix keeps the addressee responsible for refusing that relation, while the root field of willing compliance makes the danger more than outward association: the ban prevents voluntary yielding, enabling, or making the oath-wielder's authority workable through compliance. Echoes of the same refusal formula in 33:48 and 76:24, plus same-surah recurrence around 68:8 and 68:42, keep this short verb inside a broader obedience-pressure thread without changing its local object.

words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) is the mechanism that makes the refusal categorical. Its accusative case routes it back to {{ar:تُطِعْ}} ({{tr:tuṭiʿ}}) as the direct object, while its construct form binds totality to {{ar:حَلَّافٍ}} ({{tr:ḥallāfin}}). Under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), that does not mean merely "do not obey all of them together"; it excludes any member of the type being described. The singular indefinite dependent makes the scope distributive, scanning the class instance by instance. A very common totality word is made to serve a rare moral portrait here; broader prohibition patterns in 25:52 and 33:48 remain comparison points, not alternate local scope. The clipped scope word also gives the object phrase its entry before the longer descriptors expand the rhythm. Other branches of {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) remain dictionary background, but the local construction selects totality and uses it to turn a short command into a class-wide prohibition.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) as accusative direct object of {{ar:تُطِعْ}} ({{tr:tuṭiʿ}}).

words.prose: {{ar:حَلَّافٍ}} ({{tr:ḥallāfin}}) supplies the first named vice in the prohibited class. It is genitive under {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}), indefinite, and intensive, so it is not a proper name or a simple person who once swears; it is a repeatable type for whom oath-performance has become a character mark. The indictment falls on repeated performative oath-use, not merely possession of solemn oath language. The oath sense is local, while pact and alliance branches of {{ar:ح ل ف}} ({{tr:ḥ-l-f}}) sharpen the social danger: repeated oaths manufacture credibility and binding pressure, which is why oath-making becomes an obedience risk in this prohibition. The rare intensive form, doubled consonant, long vowel, and paired ending with {{ar:مَهِينٍ}} ({{tr:mahīnin}}) make the excess audible and then immediately morally sealed by the following adjective.

topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an intensive adjective, contextual evidence has this exact form as a low-occurrence unique adjective, and V4 supports the oath branch as the local semantic base.

words.prose: {{ar:مَهِينٍ}} ({{tr:mahīnin}}) lands as the ayah's closing evaluation. Its genitive indefiniteness matches {{ar:حَلَّافٍ}} ({{tr:ḥallāfin}}), so contemptibility remains inside the same object phrase and is not a detached afterthought. As an attribute it adds baseness to the oath-maker; under the appositional possibility it can restate him by the evaluation itself, while both readings keep the same target. The adjective can carry contempt, degradation, and weakness together; locally it judges the oath-wielder's authority claim as base and unworthy of obedience. Service, worn-use, and low-material branches add abasement pressure, while lowly-material uses in 32:8 and 77:20 show that kind of language transferred here into a human character portrait. The matched endings with {{ar:حَلَّافٍ}} ({{tr:ḥallāfin}}) make oath-excess and degradation close as one compact descriptor pair, even as later descriptors can continue the portrait.

topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:مَهِينٍ}} ({{tr:mahīnin}}) as a qualitative adjective, and attachment evidence links it to {{ar:حَلَّافٍ}} ({{tr:ḥallāfin}}) by agreement.

topics.reason: The local guardrail strongly licenses adjectival attachment; appositional force is retained only as a possible weight shift, not as a separate referent.

topics.reason: The lowly-material echo in 32:8 and 77:20 is retained as imagery transfer, while the local modifier remains a human character adjective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative imperative at word 2 governs the totalized oath-bearer and the final lowliness descriptor.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated swearing presents verbal assurance as a warrant for yielding, while weak standing and discernment make that warrant unfit to govern action.

activation_trace.role: Pliant yielding supplies the action explicitly withheld from the speaker.
Encompassing totality makes the warning apply across the whole class, not only one lapse.
Frequent oath-taking supplies the repeated verbal warrant that solicits trust.
Lowliness and weak discernment locate the defect in the warrant-bearer's judgment.

changed_reading.before: A bare ban on obeying a contemptible person who swears often.
changed_reading.after: A warning against converting repeated assurance into authority when the assurance-bearer lacks the judgment needed to direct conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 can involve responsive agreement, word 4 can form binding attachment, and word 5 can mark a self put into ordinary use.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker's oaths can recruit the hearer into reciprocal agreement; agreement hardens into attachment, and attachment turns the hearer's agency into a repeatedly used service.

activation_trace.role: Mutual responsiveness recasts obedience as an agreement produced between two parties.
Alliance and attached pacting make the oath a device for binding the parties together.
Putting a thing or self into routine service supplies the endpoint of captured agency.

changed_reading.before: The hearer merely receives and executes a bad order.
changed_reading.after: The hearer is warned not to enter an oath-made relationship that converts negotiated agreement into attached service.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories juxtapose loss of sharpness at word 3, cutting fluency at word 4, inner facilitation at word 2, and wear through use at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath-bearer's tongue remains sharp while repetition dulls the hearer's discrimination and wears down resistance until the self makes compliance easy.

activation_trace.role: Weariness and dulled acuity supply the hearer's possible loss of discrimination under repetition.
A sharp fluent tongue supplies the speaker's asymmetrical persuasive edge.
The self making an act easy supplies the final internalization of the speaker's pressure.
Wear through repeated use supplies the process by which resistance becomes commonplace.

changed_reading.before: The totalizer at word 3 only quantifies the people covered by the ban.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary branch activation, repeated sharp assurances may dull the hearer and make surrender feel internally effortless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated non-obedience command is immediately followed by a desired two-sided softening, so yielding is not only command execution but entry into a reciprocal accommodation bargain.

activation_trace.role: Mutual responsiveness lets the focus prohibition govern negotiated alignment as well as one-way obedience.
Binding attachment lets repeated oaths serve as the proposed bond of accommodation.
The earlier repeated prohibition fixes yielding as the action under immediate pressure.
Direct falsehood identifies the party seeking the prohibited yielding.
Two-sided soft accommodation supplies the exchange by which each side is invited to relax its stance.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats the non-obedience imperative, then places the desired concession and its reciprocal answer in one conditional movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated refusal, falsehood, and reciprocal accommodation; I infer that oath-backed persuasion brokers the exchange; live alternative: the oath-bearer may simply be one item in a vice list rather than the broker of the preceding bargain.

changed_reading.before: Do not carry out the habitual swearer's commands.
changed_reading.after: Do not enter the mutual smoothing process by which oath-backed assurances turn principled distance into reciprocal compromise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Compressed speech, mobile tale-bearing, and violent dragging make the oath-bearer a working enforcement node: reputation is pressed into language, carried between people, and converted into coercive movement.

activation_trace.role: Yielding is the behavioral result produced by the proposed enforcement workflow.
Cutting verbal fluency supplies the oath-bearer's instrument of pressure.
Practiced service permits a functional reading of the speaker as a skilled but degraded operative.
Pressure concentrated in speech supplies the first stage of reputational force.
Walking with malicious reports supplies mobility between social locations.
Speech exiting as a damaging report supplies the content that circulates.
Forceful dragging supplies the conversion of verbal pressure into coerced direction.

structural_cues: Successive intensive agent forms present recurrent operations rather than isolated accidents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressured speech, mobile reporting, tale-bearing, and forceful dragging; I connect them as stages of one enforcement workflow; live alternative: they may remain separate character faults with no causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a personally unreliable and socially low speaker.
changed_reading.after: It can also warn against a practiced reputational enforcer whose oaths, circulating reports, and coercion make other people move.

context_deltas.mechanism: External capital and lineage coexist with the focus descriptor of lowliness, forcing the descriptor away from simple poverty and toward degraded judgment, use, or moral function.

activation_trace.role: Weakness in standing or discernment supplies an inward or functional lowliness rather than an economic category.
Possession and abundance of wealth block an equation between lowliness and material lack.
Lineage and descent add social extension and inherited standing to the external-status side of the paradox.

structural_cues: The wealth-and-sons clause follows the portrait as a reason-like or circumstance-like qualification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowliness together with wealth and sons; I infer that the lowliness is not socioeconomic; live alternative: the later clause may explain rejection of signs without directly narrowing the earlier descriptor.

changed_reading.before: The prohibited figure is low because he lacks social or material standing.
changed_reading.after: He can possess wealth and lineage while remaining low through defective judgment and a degraded use of influence.

context_deltas.mechanism: An oath distributed across companions synchronizes a total plan, removes its exception, and establishes a boundary that keeps the dependent beneficiary outside.

activation_trace.role: Totality supplies the plan's pressure toward closure without remainder.
Pact and attached alliance supply the group-binding function of the oath.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the social output toward which the coordinated plan moves.
An oath apportioned among its people supplies collective synchronization rather than private emphasis.
Removing an exception closes the plan against qualification or remainder.
Entry into an interior supplies the boundary whose crossing is denied to the beneficiary.

structural_cues: The garden sequence moves from group oath, to emphatic cutting, to no exception, whispered coordination, and a stated entry ban.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered oath, exception failure, and exclusion; I infer that the oath coordinates the group and causes closure; live alternative: it may only voice a plan already formed rather than produce their solidarity.

changed_reading.before: Habitual swearing is an individual credibility defect.
changed_reading.after: Oath-taking can be a coordination technology that binds a group into a totalizing project of withholding and exclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inscribed, ordered, and judgment-bearing warrants form one evidentiary pole; claimed enduring oaths and a self-appointed guarantor form a rival pole that tries to turn assertion into authority.

activation_trace.role: Yielding supplies the jurisdictional effect sought from the rival warrant.
A disputed matter that provokes opposed oaths supplies uncertainty disguised as sworn certainty.
The prepared writing instrument supplies durable inscription as an accountable mode of warrant.
Ordered written lines supply structured record rather than improvised insistence.
A written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the missing authorization tested by the question.
Sworn oaths supply the asserted replacement for documentary authorization.
Assumed guaranty supplies the person who claims to make the unsupported entitlement hold.

structural_cues: The surah opens with writing and ordered lines, later asks for a book, then tests claimed enduring oaths and a guarantor in sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring writing, a judgment-bearing book, oaths, and guaranty; I infer an evidentiary contrast in which swearing counterfeits warrant; live alternative: written and sworn images may be parallel topics rather than deliberately opposed authorization systems.

changed_reading.before: The habitual swearer is untrustworthy because he talks too much.
changed_reading.after: He represents a counterfeit warrant system that substitutes repeated sworn force and personal guaranty for accountable authorization, then demands obedience as its ruling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root field moves from a present command not to yield to a later inability to perform when called; deliberate refusal while sound is therefore distinguished from incapacity after agency has closed.

activation_trace.role: Present pliant yielding is the voluntary response that the imperative tells the hearer to withhold.
Practical capacity makes present noncompliance an exercised choice rather than a failure of ability.
Later inability supplies the temporal reversal in which the requested response can no longer be enacted.
Prior soundness confirms an earlier interval in which responsive capacity was intact.

structural_cues: A negative imperative in the focus is answered later by negated ability, followed by recollection of earlier calls during soundness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root field in chosen refusal and later incapacity plus prior soundness; I infer a temporal contrast in agency; live alternative: the later incapacity may illustrate judgment without implying that 68:10 preserves capacity.

changed_reading.before: Non-obedience is simply a negative response to a bad person.
changed_reading.after: Non-obedience here is a positive exercise of intact agency: refuse the false claimant while refusal is still a choice, before response itself becomes unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking plus extended time activates the focus images of self-facilitation, dulling, and wear: repeated assurances can condition obedience gradually rather than secure it in one command.

activation_trace.role: Inner facilitation supplies the point at which external repetition becomes self-administered compliance.
Dulling through fatigue supplies the weakening of resistance over repeated exposures.
Wear by routine use supplies the degradation of agency into an available instrument.
Taking by successive degrees supplies the incremental shape of the conditioning process.
Extended time and respite supply the duration in which repeated pressure can become ordinary.

structural_cues: The focus uses intensive descriptions of recurrence, while the later pair explicitly joins degree-by-degree movement to temporal extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stepwise taking and extended time in a divine-action passage; I transfer only the process shape to the focus speaker and infer habituation; live alternative: the agents and purposes differ too much for that analogy to govern the focus warning.

changed_reading.before: The oath-bearer asks once and the hearer either obeys or refuses.
changed_reading.after: Habitual swearing can work as slow conditioning, wearing down acuity until the hearer's own self makes each next concession easier.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant split mapping of the focus root, so it is a secondary spatial-acoustic image, not a morphology claim. It remains anchored at focus word 2 and is reinforced by sharp speech and mobile report-bearing; downstream prose should label it an exploratory propagation analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped branch at word 2 can image rising spread, while word 4 can image a sharp tongue.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch contributes a form-distant image of something rising and spreading through the air.
Sharp verbal fluency supplies the speech that seeks a medium of propagation.
Walking malicious reports supplies the social relay that carries speech onward.
A report that exits into circulation supplies the propagated content.

changed_reading.before: Obedience only changes the hearer's own behavior.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, obedience also makes the hearer a relay through which oath-laden speech rises, travels, and recruits further social force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy rather than a claim that obedience literally means slipping. It remains anchored in mutual compliance and agency worn by use, while the context supplies coating and loss of footing; downstream prose should retain the language of 'as if' or 'can be imaged as.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Responsive agreement at word 2 and wear through use at word 5 allow obedience to be imaged as a stance made progressively easier to dislodge.

activation_trace.role: Mutual compliance supplies the relational stance that begins to give way.
Wear through repeated use supplies the progressive loss of resistant footing.
Oil or coating supplies the material image of accommodation smoothing the surface between positions.
Sliding from one's station on a surface without footing supplies the endpoint of repeated smoothing.

changed_reading.before: Accommodation is a harmless softening before a discrete decision to obey.
changed_reading.after: Accommodation can be imaged as lubrication: repeated oath-backed smoothing removes traction until the hearer slides from a held position into compliance.

strongest_changes: The warning expands from command refusal to refusal of reciprocal accommodation and oath-made attachment.
The garden sequence shows oath as collective coordination that closes exceptions and excludes a beneficiary.
Writing, book, enduring-oath, and guarantor cues expose habitual swearing as a counterfeit warrant system.
The later inability at 68:42 turns present non-obedience into an exercise of intact agency rather than mere negativity.
Wealth and lineage force the lowliness descriptor away from material poverty toward degraded judgment and use of influence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories supported an unusual asymmetry between a sharp oath-bearing tongue and a hearer dulled through repetition. Context then activated social, legal, temporal, and material versions of the same capture process without collapsing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The pact-and-service model is branch-grounded but not forced by the surface syntax.
The contrast between accountable inscription and sworn assertion is abductive rather than explicitly stated.
The incremental-wear model and both outliers depend on analogical transfer and should remain visibly qualified.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Total refusal of oath-manufactured authority.** `ط و ع B001` gives obedience, `ك ل ل B003` totality, `ح ل ف B001` habitual swearing, and `م ه ن B001` low standing or weak judgment. The universal quantifier scopes the type, not one isolated oath. I infer repeated swearing is being used to compensate for deficient credibility; the ayah forbids treating oath volume as authority.
2. **A binding form degraded into service.** `ح ل ف B002` supplies pact and binding attachment, while `م ه ن B002/B005` supplies service and being worn through ordinary use. Later 68:17 has owners swear over a crop and 68:39 asks about binding oaths. I infer excessive use -> erosion of the binding form's worth; *ḥallāf mahīn* can thus name one who reduces solemn attachment to a low instrument of self-service.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The garden oath in 68:17 demonstrates how emphatic swearing can bind speakers to a morally defective plan, and 68:39 asks whether any oath can truly bind the final outcome. Together they make habitual swearing look like an attempt to manufacture reach that the oath does not possess.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Oath-speech that dulls the faculty it claims to secure.** Fixed `كُلَّ` activates `ك ل ل B001` (weariness and loss of sharpness in tongue, eye, or hearing), while fixed `حَلَّاف` activates `ح ل ف B004` (sharp cutting eloquence). The packet supplies habitual swearing beside repeated seeing/knowing in 68:5-7; I infer that incessant verbal sharpness eventually blunts discrimination in its audience. `كُلَّ حَلَّاف` can thus diagnose an exhausting speech regime, not just quantify oath-makers.
2. **A low-status functionary in a circulation system.** Fixed `مَّهِين` activates `م ه ن B002` (service and practiced work-skill), and 68:11 supplies the walking carrier of tale-bearing. The packet supplies a servant-like role followed by mobile transmission; I infer that the described person performs skilled service for a wider misinformation network. “Low” then marks dependence and function as well as contemptibility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:11 supplied the missing job description: walking tale-bearing made fixed `مَّهِين` activate practiced service (`م ه ن B002`). 68:15 then showed the network's product, a ready-made “old tales” classification.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Covers Regulate Access to Sight and Interior Truth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seeing and knowing depend on whether a physical, mental, or social cover protects, obscures, or reveals what lies within.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The charge of madness is reframed as an argument about covered interiors: eye-films, shields, shelters, ribs, and unspoken thought all test what observers can legitimately infer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Shield, Shelter, and Covering Skin
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Leather, cloth, armor, and a screened place interpose a fitted layer between a vulnerable occupant and exterior force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); hiding-place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); worn armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`); tent-like insect screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m01`); leather shelter or groundsheet (`quranic:root_000156:B004/m01`); leather saddle-cover (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Concealment is not only epistemic failure. The same invariant produces armor, shelter, and screened habitation, so a cover can preserve a life even as another cover prevents an observer from seeing truly.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Chest Frames Speech and Character
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ribs and thick bones form a load-bearing chest around the heart, while tongue and sharp articulation carry the enclosed person outward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: chest-rib ends (`quranic:root_000266:B016/m01`); ribs and structural supports (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m01`); thick limb segment (`quranic:root_001029:B003/m01`); hard bone (`quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`); chest (`quranic:root_001315:B007/m01`); tongue as speech instrument (`quranic:root_001272:B002/m01`); sharp, fluent tongue (`quranic:root_000349:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The person appears as a built interior: ribs and bone hold the chest, and the tongue projects what the chest contains. This anatomical scene gives material form to the pericope’s contrast between inward character and outward verbal aggression.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Direction Can Guide Bodies or Circulate Harm
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Movement acquires moral and social force through its route, guide, gait, and carried content.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Tale-bearing becomes a corrupted form of wayfaring: the same moving body that can follow a guide can also transport injury between people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gait Registers Capacity, Terrain, and Exhaustion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler moves on foot across edges and uneven ground; fatigue, bodily weakness, or reliance on companions alters the gait.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate walking (`quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`); running (`quranic:root_000993:B002/m01`); bank or side of a route (`quranic:root_000993:B009/m01`); hard uneven ground (`quranic:root_000993:B010/m01`); travel on foot (`quranic:root_001525:B012/m01`); supported swaying walk (`quranic:root_001583:B008/m01`); calm, composed gait (`quranic:root_001583:B010/m01`); exhaustion of walker or mount (`quranic:root_001315:B001/m01`); body worn down by use (`quranic:root_001453:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Movement discloses condition. The same route can carry a runner, an exhausted mount, a composed traveler, or a weakened pedestrian, so gait becomes a visible measure of agency rather than a neutral change of place.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tale-Bearing Is Speech Put on Foot
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker extracts a damaging report, carries it from place to place, and presses or prods others with it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: walking with tales (`quranic:root_001427:B004/m01`); emitted slander (`quranic:root_001557:B002/m01`); betraying whisper or footfall (`quranic:root_001557:B003/m02`); circulating public report (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m02`); prod that sets a body in motion (`quranic:root_001600:B003/m01`); defamation (`quranic:root_001600:B004/m01`); clamorous crowd (`quranic:root_000349:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The collocation in 68:11 is internally mechanized: the tale exits, the carrier walks, and the verbal prod moves its target. Rumor is thus a transported force with an itinerary and social impact.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority is enacted by keeping charge, binding parties, directing motion, or deciding whether restraint continues.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lordship, contract, bridle-like obedience, coercive hauling, and release from captivity occupy one field of controlled attachment without being reduced to one moral value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covenant, Surety, and Attached Membership
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An oath or covenant fastens people to one another; a surety carries another’s obligation, and an attached outsider acquires a disputed membership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: alliance and binding pact (`quranic:root_000349:B002/m01`); covenant and protected relation (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); liability that follows its bearer (`quranic:root_000186:B004/m01`); standing surety (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`); member attached to a group not originally his (`quranic:root_000647:B002/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Social belonging is represented as an attachment that can arise through oath, guarantee, or annexation. The marked outsider is therefore not merely an insult but the unstable edge of a binding social mechanism.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Obedience, Refusal, and Coercive Hauling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A command seeks smooth compliance; resistance hardens into mutual pushing or refusal, and force then drags the resistant body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: obedient following (`quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`); mutual compliance (`quranic:root_000956:B002/m01`); the self making action easy (`quranic:root_000956:B006/m01`); violent hauling (`quranic:root_000980:B001/m01`); refusal to move or submit (`quranic:root_000980:B005/m01`); servant or enforcer (`quranic:root_000980:B006/m01`); transgressive overstepping (`quranic:root_000993:B001/m01`); obstructing barrier (`quranic:root_001448:B002/m01`); protected force (`quranic:root_001448:B003/m01`); mutual resistance (`quranic:root_001448:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Compliance ranges from willing alignment to reciprocal accommodation. Against it stand barrier, fortified resistance, and the brutal hauling encoded by `عُتُلّ`, giving the prohibition on obedience a concrete politics of who directs whose body.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Provision Builds Households or Is Arrested at the Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material good becomes socially meaningful through giving, nurturing, earning, withholding, and household reproduction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wealth and sons are not static possessions; lexical scenes show provision moving through wages, gifts, marriage, livestock, and care, or failing through blocked hands and depleted stores.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Withholding Hand Produces Scarcity and Weakness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hand refuses transfer, a barrier blocks access, and the resulting shortage appears as scant water, little milk, depleted strength, or an emptied belly.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hand withheld from giving (`quranic:root_001448:B001/m01`); barrier to desired access (`quranic:root_001448:B002/m02`); weakness and contempt (`quranic:root_001453:B001/m01`); scant water or sterile issue (`quranic:root_001453:B006/m01`); little milk (`quranic:root_000497:B006/m01`); lost strength (`quranic:root_001449:B002/m01`); camel belly retaining no water (`quranic:root_001557:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Withholding is rendered hydrologically and bodily. What begins as a social refusal at the hand terminates in low milk, low water, weak reproductive force, and an emptied animal, making deprivation a material outcome rather than only a vice.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Affiliation Distinguishes Household Member, Ally, and Attached Outsider
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A populous group organizes around a leader and kin; alliance can attach outsiders, but distance of lineage and visible tagging preserve status differences.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tagged outsider (`quranic:root_000647:B002/m03`); distant kin (`quranic:root_000131:B005/m01`); alliance (`quranic:root_000349:B002/m02`); assembled tribal groups (`quranic:root_000532:B004/m01`); herd as social aggregate (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m01`); mass of people (`quranic:root_000266:B013/m01`); regional chief (`quranic:root_001272:B004/m02`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Assay Exposes Formation and Moral Texture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Pressure reveals whether a formed thing is sound, rough, delayed, brittle, or fit for its intended work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Character is treated like material under assay: measured before formation, tested by fire or ordeal, and disclosed through hardness, lag, excess, and capacity for repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lag, Roughness, and Overstepping Reveal Defective Material
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject lags behind good, crosses a boundary, resists easy handling, and presents a coarse or blunt texture under pressure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covered Garden, Grain Ear, and Aromatic Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water drives enclosing vegetation upward; grain extends into ears, low plants spread, and aromatic growth announces itself by scent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense rising vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); persistent green plant (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`); extended grain ear (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); low salt plant (`quranic:root_001252:B007/m01`); halfa grass (`quranic:root_000349:B005/m01`); aromatic plant disclosed by smell (`quranic:root_001557:B004/m01`); summer browse after spring (`quranic:root_000993:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a succession of plant forms rather than a generic “nature” motif. Enclosure, upward density, earing grain, low browse, and scent each mark a different stage or mode by which provision occupies the land.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Herd, Milk, and the Risk of Depletion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A herd is maintained through recent birth, watering, milking, and pasture; shortage appears as low milk, weak issue, or a stray animal outside ownership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: recently delivered milk-animal (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); herd of cattle or camels (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m02`); livestock wealth (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); milking camels at the chest (`quranic:root_001453:B004/m01`); low milk and weakness (`quranic:root_000497:B006/m02`); scant reproductive fluid (`quranic:root_001453:B006/m02`); ownerless stray camel (`quranic:root_000913:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The herd makes wealth biologically contingent. Birth, milk, pasture, and ownership must remain aligned; weakness, low yield, or straying breaks the sequence by which living assets reproduce provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Fitted Parts Make Shelters, Implements, and Cuts
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material becomes functional by cutting, joining, tensioning, or arranging parts into a load-bearing whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The writing tool belongs to a larger craft world of stitched leather, tent frames, bows, lots, clubs, and terminal cuts; “whole” and “part” are physical operations before they become discourse categories.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stitched Leather Stretches Across a Wooden Frame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Poles, ribs, and saddle wood support a fitted leather or cloth cover whose seams create a protected interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: carrying frame or tent poles (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`); leather dome or groundsheet (`quranic:root_000156:B004/m02`); ribs and house-posts (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m02`); saddle wood (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); leather saddle-cover (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m02`); protective screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m02`); joining two hides or cloth panels (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The shelter is a distributed assembly: frame, posts, saddle wood, cover, and seam. Its coherence rests on fitted tension, giving the pericope a concrete model for how separate parts become a protective whole.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Discourse Operators Allocate Reference, Scope, and Sequence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A claim becomes intelligible by selecting its referent, setting its scope, and locating it before, after, or at an outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The pericope’s contest over “which of you,” “every,” “other than,” and “former” has a latent architecture of questioning, totalization, exception, succession, and return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Totality, Exception, Priority, and Outcome Bound the Claim
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A discourse gathers all parts, excludes or contrasts one, orders what comes first and after, and finally returns an expression to its outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: total inclusion (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); difference, exception, or negation (`quranic:root_001119:B005/m01`); firstness and priority (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`); return to outcome or interpretation (`quranic:root_000067:B002/m01`); temporal succession after (`quranic:root_000131:B002/m01`); following in sequence (`quranic:root_000186:B001/m01`); remainder that follows (`quranic:root_000186:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Scope and sequence jointly regulate interpretation. `كُلّ` gathers, `غَيْر` removes or contrasts, `أَوَّل` establishes precedence, and the following/after/outcome senses determine how a statement continues and where it finally lands.

root_profile.summary: Bu kökte anlam ağı, zorlamaya karşı isteyerek yönelme ve bir işin kolayca gerçekleşebilir hale gelmesi çevresinde düzenlenir. Dallar, kişilerin boyun eğmesi ve uyumundan güç yetirme, kendini zorlama, gönüllü iyilik, iç yöneliş ve otlak ya da meyvenin kullanılabilir hale gelmesine açılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin havada uzaması, yükselmesi veya yayılması ortak ekseninde ışık, şimşek, toz, koku, sabah aydınlığı ve ok örneklerini bir araya getirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu hareket ve görünüş çekirdeğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Boyun uzunluğu, ev direği, boyundaki damga, vuruş ve dağ adı bu dalın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın kullanımdaki havada uzama, yükselme ve yayılma çekirdeğini verir; okun gökte belirmesi ve kokunun buruna ulaşması gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin havaya doğru uzaması, yükselmesi ya da çevreye yayılmasıdır. Işık, şimşek, sabah aydınlığı, toz ve koku bu görünüşle anlatılır; okun gökte belirmesi ve kokunun buruna ulaşması bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Bir şey havada uzar, yükselir veya çevreye yayılır.
Işık, şimşek ve sabah aydınlığı göğe doğru yükselerek ya da uzanarak görünür.
Toz ve koku yükselip havaya yayılır.
Atılan ok gökte yükselip belirginleşir ve parlar.
Yayılan güzel koku kişinin burnuna ulaşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı havada uzama, yükselme ve yayılmayı temel alır; ışık ve şimşek gibi görünen olguların yanı sıra toz ve koku da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır. Tahdhib, atılan okun gökte yükselip belirginleşmesini ve kokunun yayılıp duyulmasını özel örnekler olarak ayrıca verir.
